in_marathi.name: Vinayagam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vinayagam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vinayagam is derived from the Tamil word ‘Vinayagam’ which means ‘Lord of the new beginnings and the Lord who bestows wisdom’. This name is associated with Lord Ganesha, who is revered as the God of wisdom, knowledge, new beginnings, and the remover of obstacles.
